message.content:
A typical **medium-sized** (about 182 g) raw apple contains roughly **90–100 kcal**—usually cited around **95 kcal**.  

Calories can vary slightly:

| Apple Size | Approximate Weight | Calories |
|------------|--------------------|----------|
| Small      | ~150 g             | ~80‑85   |
| Medium     | ~180 g             | ~95      |
| Large      | ~220 g             | ~110‑115 |

These values assume the fruit is eaten raw without added sugar or toppings. If you slice it into pieces or add butter/peanut butter, those extras will increase the total caloric intake.
